These are real, well-known repositories, but ALL numbers (stars, forks, issues, dates, stars_gained_30d) are APPROXIMATE and the github_id values are placeholders (9000000xx), not the real GitHub ids. repos.description: Flutter makes it easy and fast to build beautiful apps for mobile and beyond
repos.readme:
# Flutter

Flutter is Google's SDK for crafting beautiful, fast user experiences for mobile, web, and desktop from a single codebase. It works with existing code, is used by developers and organizations around the world, and is free and open source.

Flutter apps are written in Dart and compiled to native ARM or JavaScript/WebAssembly. Hot reload lets you see changes in under a second without losing app state.

## Quick start

```bash
# install the SDK from https://docs.flutter.dev/get-started/install, then
flutter doctor
flutter create my_app
cd my_app
flutter run
```

Everything on screen is a widget: compose small widgets such as `Row`, `Column` and `Text` to build complex layouts.

repos.description: The Dart SDK, including the VM, JS and Wasm compilers, analysis, core libraries, and more.
repos.readme:
# Dart SDK

Dart is a client-optimized language for fast apps on any platform. This repository contains the Dart VM, the dart2js and dart2wasm compilers, the analyzer, the core libraries and the `dart` command line tool.

Dart offers sound null safety, async/await, and both JIT compilation (fast development cycles) and AOT compilation (fast startup in production).

## Usage

```bash
dart create -t console hello
cd hello
dart run
```

Use `dart pub add <package>` to add packages from pub.dev, and `dart test` to run tests.

repos.description: A predictable state management library that helps implement the BLoC design pattern
repos.readme:
# Bloc

Bloc is a predictable state management library for Dart and Flutter. It separates presentation from business logic, which makes code fast, easy to test and reusable.

A `Cubit` exposes functions that emit new states; a `Bloc` receives events and maps them to states.

## Install

```bash
flutter pub add flutter_bloc
```

```dart
class CounterCubit extends Cubit<int> {
  CounterCubit() : super(0);
  void increment() => emit(state + 1);
}
```

Wrap your widget tree with `BlocProvider` and rebuild UI with `BlocBuilder`.

repos.description: A reactive caching and data-binding framework. Riverpod makes working with asynchronous code a breeze.

A powerful HTTP client for Dart and Flutter, which supports global settings, interceptors, FormData, aborting and canceling a request, files uploading and downloading, requests timeout, custom adapters, etc.
repos.readme:
# dio

dio is a powerful HTTP networking package for Dart and Flutter. It supports global configuration, interceptors, FormData, request cancellation, file upload/download, timeouts and custom adapters.

## Install

```bash
flutter pub add dio
```

```dart
final dio = Dio(BaseOptions(baseUrl: 'https://api.example.com'));
final response = await dio.get('/repos', queryParameters: {'page': 1});
print(response.data);
```

Add an `InterceptorsWrapper` to attach auth headers or log every request.

repos.description: FastAPI framework, high performance, easy to learn, fast to code, ready for production
repos.readme:
# FastAPI

FastAPI is a modern, fast (high-performance) web framework for building APIs with Python based on standard type hints. It gives you automatic data validation with Pydantic and interactive OpenAPI documentation out of the box.

## Install

```bash
pip install "fastapi[standard]"
```

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI()

@app.get("/items/{item_id}")
def read_item(item_id: int, q: str | None = None):
    return {"item_id": item_id, "q": q}
```

Run it with `fastapi dev main.py` and open http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs for the Swagger UI.

repos.description: Build context-aware reasoning applications
repos.readme:
# LangChain

LangChain is a framework for developing applications powered by large language models. It provides standard interfaces for chat models, embeddings, vector stores and retrievers, plus integrations with hundreds of providers.

Use it to build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, tool-using agents and chatbots.

## Install

```bash
pip install -U langchain langchain-openai
```

```python
from langchain.chat_models import init_chat_model

model = init_chat_model("gpt-4o-mini", model_provider="openai")
print(model.invoke("Explain RAG in one sentence").content)
```

For stateful, multi-step agents see LangGraph.

repos.description: Get up and running with large language models locally.
repos.readme:
# Ollama

Ollama lets you run open large language models such as Llama, Gemma, Qwen and Mistral on your own machine. It bundles model weights, configuration and a runtime into a single package and exposes a simple REST API.

## Install

```bash
# macOS / Windows: download from https://ollama.com/download
curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh   # Linux
ollama run llama3.2
```

The API listens on port 11434:

```bash
curl http://localhost:11434/api/generate -d '{"model": "llama3.2", "prompt": "Why is the sky blue?"}'
```

Create custom models with a `Modelfile`.

repos.description: The React Framework
repos.readme:
# Next.js

Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. It offers file-based routing, server components, server-side rendering, static generation and API routes, with fast builds powered by Turbopack.

## Get started

```bash
npx create-next-app@latest my-app
cd my-app
npm run dev
```

Pages live in the `app/` directory: `app/page.tsx` is the home page and `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx` a dynamic route.

Deploy anywhere Node.js runs, or on Vercel with zero configuration.

repos.description: The Postgres development platform. Supabase gives you a dedicated Postgres database to build your web, mobile, and AI applications.
repos.readme:
# Supabase

Supabase is an open source Firebase alternative built on Postgres. Every project gets a dedicated Postgres database, authentication, instant REST and GraphQL APIs, realtime subscriptions, storage and edge functions.

## Quick start

```bash
npm install @supabase/supabase-js
```

```js
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'

const supabase = createClient('https://xyz.supabase.co', 'public-anon-key')
const { data } = await supabase.from('todos').select('*')
```

Run the whole stack locally with `npx supabase start` (requires Docker).

repos.description: The library for web and native user interfaces.
Visual Studio Code
repos.readme:
# Visual Studio Code - Open Source ("Code - OSS")

This repository is where Visual Studio Code is developed. VS Code combines the simplicity of a code editor with powerful developer tooling such as IntelliSense, debugging, Git integration and a huge extension ecosystem.

## Build from source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/microsoft/vscode.git
cd vscode
npm install
./scripts/code.sh    # scripts\code.bat on Windows
```

Extensions are written in TypeScript against the `vscode` API; scaffold one with `npx yo code`.

repos.description: Transformers: the model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning models in text, vision, audio, and multimodal models, for both inference and training.
repos.readme:
# Transformers

Transformers provides thousands of pretrained models for text, vision, audio and multimodal tasks. Download a model from the Hugging Face Hub, run inference in a few lines, and fine-tune it on your own data.

## Install

```bash
pip install transformers torch
```

```python
from transformers import pipeline

classifier = pipeline("sentiment-analysis")
print(classifier("DevRadar makes discovering repos fun!"))
```

The `Trainer` API handles training loops, mixed precision and distributed training.

repos.description: Tensors and Dynamic neural networks in Python with strong GPU acceleration
repos.readme:
# PyTorch

PyTorch is a Python package that provides tensor computation with strong GPU acceleration and deep neural networks built on a tape-based autograd system.

## Install

```bash
pip install torch torchvision
```

```python
import torch

x = torch.rand(3, 3, device="cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = torch.nn.Linear(3, 1)
print(model(x))
```

Use `torch.compile(model)` to speed up training and inference.

repos.description: An Open Source Machine Learning Framework for Everyone
repos.readme:
# TensorFlow

TensorFlow is an end-to-end open source platform for machine learning. It has a comprehensive ecosystem of tools and libraries for building and deploying ML models, from research to production on servers, browsers and mobile devices (TensorFlow Lite).

## Install

```bash
pip install tensorflow
```

```python
import tensorflow as tf

model = tf.keras.Sequential([tf.keras.layers.Dense(10, activation="relu"), tf.keras.layers.Dense(1)])
model.compile(optimizer="adam", loss="mse")
```

Train with `model.fit(x, y, epochs=5)`.

repos.description: LLM inference in C/C++
repos.readme:
# llama.cpp

llama.cpp enables LLM inference with minimal setup and state-of-the-art performance on a wide range of hardware, locally and in the cloud. It is plain C/C++ without dependencies, with Apple Silicon, CUDA, Vulkan and CPU backends and 1.5 to 8-bit quantization (GGUF format).

## Quick start

```bash
brew install llama.cpp          # or build: cmake -B build && cmake --build build
llama-cli -hf ggml-org/gemma-3-1b-it-GGUF
llama-server -hf ggml-org/gemma-3-1b-it-GGUF --port 8080
```

`llama-server` exposes an OpenAI-compatible API.

repos.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repos.readme:
# Open WebUI

Open WebUI is an extensible, self-hosted AI interface that works fully offline. It supports Ollama and any OpenAI-compatible API, with a built-in RAG engine, document upload, web search and user management.

## Install with Docker

```bash
docker run -d -p 3000:8080 -v open-webui:/app/backend/data --name open-webui ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main
```

Or with pip:

```bash
pip install open-webui
open-webui serve
```

Then open http://localhost:3000 and create the admin account.

repos.description: A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs
repos.readme:
# vLLM

vLLM is a fast and easy-to-use library for LLM inference and serving. PagedAttention and continuous batching give it very high throughput, and it offers an OpenAI-compatible server.

## Install

```bash
pip install vllm
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
```

```python
from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams

llm = LLM(model="facebook/opt-125m")
print(llm.generate(["Hello, my name is"], SamplingParams(temperature=0.8))[0].outputs[0].text)
```

repos.description: LlamaIndex is the leading framework for building LLM-powered agents over your data.
repos.readme:
# LlamaIndex

LlamaIndex is a data framework for LLM applications. It helps you ingest, index and query your own data (PDFs, APIs, SQL databases) and build RAG pipelines and agents on top of it.

## Install

```bash
pip install llama-index
```

```python
from llama_index.core import SimpleDirectoryReader, VectorStoreIndex

documents = SimpleDirectoryReader("data").load_data()
index = VectorStoreIndex.from_documents(documents)
print(index.as_query_engine().query("What is this project about?"))
```

repos.description: A programming framework for agentic AI
repos.readme:
# AutoGen

AutoGen is a framework for creating multi-agent AI applications that can act autonomously or work alongside humans. Agents talk to each other, call tools and write and run code.

## Install

```bash
pip install -U "autogen-agentchat" "autogen-ext[openai]"
```

```python
import asyncio
from autogen_agentchat.agents import AssistantAgent
from autogen_ext.models.openai import OpenAIChatCompletionClient

async def main():
    agent = AssistantAgent("assistant", OpenAIChatCompletionClient(model="gpt-4o-mini"))
    print(await agent.run(task="Say hello"))

asyncio.run(main())
```

repos.description: A utility-first CSS framework for rapid UI development.
repos.readme:
# Tailwind CSS Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework for rapidly building custom user interfaces. Instead of writing CSS, you compose classes like `flex`, `pt-4` and `text-center` directly in your markup. ## Install (Vite) ```bash npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite ``` ```css /* app.css */ @import "tailwindcss"; ``` ```html

Hello world!

```

repos.description: Next generation frontend tooling. It's fast!
repos.readme:
# Vite

Vite is a frontend build tool that gives you a very fast dev server with instant Hot Module Replacement, and an optimized production build using Rollup.

## Get started

```bash
npm create vite@latest my-app -- --template react-ts
cd my-app
npm install
npm run dev
```

Configure plugins and aliases in `vite.config.ts`; build for production with `npm run build`.

repos.description: web development for the rest of us
repos.readme:
# Svelte

Svelte is a new way to build web applications. It is a compiler that takes your declarative components and converts them into efficient JavaScript that surgically updates the DOM.

## Get started

```bash
npx sv create my-app
cd my-app
npm install
npm run dev
```

```svelte
<script>
  let count = $state(0);
</script>

<button onclick={() => count++}>clicks: {count}</button>
```

repos.description: A modern runtime for JavaScript and TypeScript.
repos.readme:
# Deno

Deno is a JavaScript, TypeScript and WebAssembly runtime with secure defaults and a great developer experience. TypeScript works out of the box, and it ships a formatter, linter and test runner.

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh     # macOS / Linux
irm https://deno.land/install.ps1 | iex          # Windows PowerShell
```

```ts
Deno.serve((_req) => new Response("Hello, world!"));
```

Run it with `deno run --allow-net server.ts`.

repos.description: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.
repos.readme:
# uv

uv is an extremely fast Python package and project manager written in Rust. It replaces pip, pip-tools, pipx, poetry, pyenv and virtualenv, and is 10-100x faster than pip.

## Install

```bash
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
# Windows: powershell -c "irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex"
```

```bash
uv init my-project
cd my-project
uv add fastapi
uv run main.py
```

`uv python install 3.12` installs Python versions too.

repos.description: An extremely fast Python linter and code formatter, written in Rust.
repos.readme:
# Ruff

Ruff is an extremely fast Python linter and code formatter, written in Rust. It can replace Flake8 (plus dozens of plugins), isort, pydocstyle and Black while running 10-100x faster.

## Install

```bash
pip install ruff
```

```bash
ruff check .          # lint
ruff check --fix .    # lint and auto-fix
ruff format .         # format
```

Configure it in `pyproject.toml` under `[tool.ruff]`.

repos.description: Next-generation ORM for Node.js & TypeScript | PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, MongoDB and CockroachDB
repos.readme:
# Prisma

Prisma is a next-generation ORM for Node.js and TypeScript. You describe your data model in a Prisma schema, and Prisma generates a type-safe query client and SQL migrations.

## Get started

```bash
npm install prisma --save-dev
npx prisma init --datasource-provider postgresql
npx prisma migrate dev --name init
```

```ts
const users = await prisma.user.findMany({ where: { email: { contains: 'dev' } } })
```

repos.description: DuckDB is an analytical in-process SQL database management system
repos.readme:
# DuckDB

DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system that runs inside your process, like SQLite, but is built for fast analytical (OLAP) queries. It reads CSV, Parquet and JSON files directly.

## Install

```bash
pip install duckdb
```

```python
import duckdb

duckdb.sql("SELECT language, count(*) FROM 'repos.parquet' GROUP BY language").show()
```

A standalone CLI is also available: `duckdb my.db`.

repos.description: Open Source realtime backend in 1 file
repos.readme:
# PocketBase

PocketBase is an open source backend in a single file: an embedded SQLite database with realtime subscriptions, built-in authentication, file storage and an admin dashboard.

## Run

```bash
# download the zip for your OS from https://github.com/pocketbase/pocketbase/releases
./pocketbase serve
```

Open http://127.0.0.1:8090/_/ to create collections. Use the JavaScript or Dart SDK from your app:

```bash
flutter pub add pocketbase
```

repos.description: Playwright is a framework for Web Testing and Automation. It allows testing Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with a single API.
A set of beautifully-designed, accessible components and a code distribution platform.
repos.readme:
# shadcn/ui

shadcn/ui is a set of beautifully designed, accessible React components built with Radix UI and Tailwind CSS. It is not a dependency: you copy the components into your project and own the code.

## Get started

```bash
npx shadcn@latest init
npx shadcn@latest add button
```

```tsx
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

export default function Home() {
  return <Button>Click me</Button>
}
```
